items.title: TSRX in TanStack Start: What We Like, and Three Bugs We Filed
items.blurb: TanStack Start is our default for new TypeScript projects. We paired it with TSRX, a JSX successor built for co-located structure and AI-native codebases, and stress-tested every language feature. Client-side it's a clear win.
